universe_rationale: One deliberately fixed familiar liquid survivor from each broad industry group. Engineering/mechanism pilot only; not PIT universe membership or representative selection performance.

trigger_definitions.technical_core_t12: engine.signal_gate.gate on each exact prefix, washout_waiver=False, event_latch=None, eligible T1/T2; not a replay of the context-waived/live-latched board
trigger_definitions.trend_126_20_50: close > close[-126] AND trailing SMA20 > trailing SMA50
trigger_definitions.breakout_63: close > max of the PRIOR 63 closes, excluding current close
trigger_definitions.pullback_reclaim_20: close > close[-126] AND prior close <= prior SMA20 AND current close > current SMA20

context_definitions.unfiltered: No regime gate, evaluated on the common market-context-known frame
context_definitions.market_uptrend: SPY close > trailing SMA200 AND current SMA200 > SMA200 from 20 sessions earlier
context_definitions.no_volatility_stress: SPY trailing 21-session daily-return standard deviation <= 1.5 times trailing 252-session daily-return standard deviation

onset_rule: A true trigger after three known false observations; unknown history does not establish a fresh event. Regime applied to those same frozen trigger events, never refired after filtering.
non_goals: touch frozen W3 or November-19 W2 outcomes
infer portfolio CAGR from overlapping trades
